VegaWidgetSettings.title: The title drawn above the chart. Empty draws none.
VegaWidgetSettings.renderer: Canvas or SVG. Canvas stays fast with thousands of marks; SVG stays sharp when zoomed.
VegaWidgetSettings.tooltip: Whether a mark shows its values in a tooltip while the pointer is over it. Tooltip encodings choose the values; without one a mark shows all of its fields.
VegaWidgetSettings.legendPosition: Where the legends stand; none hides every legend.
VegaWidgetSettings.layers: The layers of the chart, drawn in this order - the first one at the bottom. One layer is a plain chart; a second one adds, for example, points on a line or a rule on bars.
VegaWidgetSettings.facet: Splits the chart into small multiples, one per value of a field. Empty draws a single chart.
VegaWidgetSettings.params: Selections and values the chart holds: what is picked or brushed, and values other settings refer to by name.
VegaWidgetSettings.datasets: The data the chart draws, by name. Without an entry the data source of the widget is the dataset table; an entry named table without a source of its own says how to read that one.
VegaWidgetSettings.starter: Replaces the layers, selections and small multiples with this chart, filled with columns of the data. Then the choice is empty again; "Discard" brings the chart back.
VegaWidgetSettings.independentScales: The channels whose scale each layer has for itself: y gives every layer its own y axis - a temperature on the left, a precipitation on the right. Only read with more than one layer or with small multiples.
VegaWidgetSettings.references: Constant lines and bands drawn with the chart: limits, targets, zones, a date. They belong to the whole chart and share its scales, so a band from 0 to 1.8 lies where 0 and 1.8 are on the axis. Not drawn in small multiples.

DatasetBinding.name: The name layers use for this dataset. table is the data source of the widget.
DatasetBinding.datasourceId: The board data source the dataset comes from. Empty: the data source of the widget.
DatasetBinding.shape: The form the dataset is asked for. The data source of the widget itself is always read as a table, so that the part of it the frame selects is what the chart draws.
DatasetBinding.path: For the shape object: where the list of rows is in the answer, as names separated by dots (data.items). Empty: the answer itself.
DatasetBinding.columnTypes: Columns read as numbers, dates or booleans rather than as they arrive.

Layer.dataset: The name of the dataset the layer draws. Empty draws the dataset of the widget, named table.
Layer.mark: The kind of mark the layer draws.
Layer.interpolate: How a line, area or trail runs between its points. Ignored by other marks.
Layer.showPoints: Whether a line, area or trail also draws a point at each value.
Layer.filled: Whether a point, circle or square is filled rather than drawn as an outline.
Layer.color: A fixed colour for every mark of the layer, as a CSS colour. Empty takes the colour of the theme or of a colour encoding.
Layer.opacity: The opacity of the marks, from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).
Layer.cornerRadius: Rounds the corners of bars, rects and arcs by this many pixels; 0 keeps them sharp.
Layer.innerRadius: The inner radius of an arc in pixels: 0 draws a pie, more draws a donut. Ignored by other marks.
Layer.strokeWidth: The width of lines and outlines in pixels; 0 takes the default.
Layer.encodings: What drives the marks: which field goes to which channel, and how.
Layer.transforms: Steps applied to the data before the layer draws it, in this order.

Encoding.field: The field of the dataset that drives the channel. Empty with a value set uses the value; empty with the aggregate count counts the rows.
Encoding.type: What the values of the field are.
Encoding.aggregate: How values that fall on the same place are combined.
Encoding.bin: Whether the values are grouped into bins - a histogram is a binned x with a count on y.
Encoding.maxBins: The largest number of bins; 0 lets Vega-Lite choose.
Encoding.timeUnit: The part of a point in time the channel uses, for example the month to compare months across years.
Encoding.sort: How the values along the channel are ordered.
Encoding.stack: How marks on the same position stack. Only read on a position channel.
Encoding.title: The title of the axis or legend. Empty takes the name of the field.
Encoding.format: How values are written on the axis, in the legend or in the text: a d3 number format (,.2f) or, for points in time, a d3 time format (%Y-%m). Empty takes the default.
Encoding.value: A fixed value for the channel when no field drives it, for example a colour or an opacity. Numbers are read as numbers.
Encoding.scaleType: How values are mapped to the channel.
Encoding.scaleZero: Whether a quantitative scale includes zero. Turned off, the scale fits the values.
Encoding.domainMin: The lowest value the scale shows. Empty fits the data.
Encoding.domainMax: The highest value the scale shows. Empty fits the data.
Encoding.scheme: A Vega colour scheme for a colour encoding, for example tableau10, blues or viridis. Empty takes the colours of the theme.
Encoding.showAxis: Whether a position channel draws its axis.
Encoding.showGrid: Whether the axis draws grid lines.
Encoding.labelAngle: The angle of the axis labels in degrees, for example -45. Empty lets Vega-Lite choose.
Encoding.showLegend: Whether a colour, size, shape or opacity channel draws its legend.
Encoding.highlightParam: The name of a selection. Marks the selection holds keep the field or value above; the others take the value below - this is how a selection highlights.
Encoding.valueIfNotSelected: The value the marks outside the selection take, for example lightgray or 0.2.
Encoding.scaleEntries: Each listed value of the field is drawn as its own output - a colour, a shape, a size, an opacity - rather than as the scheme picks. List every value, or none: a value not listed gets no output of its own.
Encoding.axisOrient: The side the axis of this position channel is drawn on. Automatic: x below, y left.

Facet.row: The field whose values make the rows. Empty makes no rows.
Facet.column: The field whose values make the columns. Empty makes no columns.
Facet.columns: With only a column field: the number of columns before the charts wrap to the next row; 0 never wraps.

Param.name: The name the encodings, filters and board actions use. Letters, digits and underscore.
Param.fields: The fields a selection projects on: picking one mark then selects every mark with the same values. Empty selects single marks.
Param.encodings: The channels an interval spans, usually x, or x and y. Empty spans both.
Param.bind: What the selection is bound to.
Param.value: The initial value, as JSON - for a value parameter its value, for a selection what it holds at the start. Empty starts empty.

ScaleEntry.value: The value of the field, as it appears in the data. A number may be written as text.
ScaleEntry.output: What the value is drawn as: a CSS colour for colour, a shape name (circle, square, triangle-up, ...) for shape, a number for size and opacity.

Reference.kind: A line at one value, or a band between two.
Reference.channel: y draws it across the chart at a value of the y axis; x draws it upright at a value of the x axis.
Reference.type: What the values are: numbers, or points in time on a time axis.
Reference.from: The value of the line; for a band its lower end. A point in time is written as ISO 8601 text (2026-11-07T12:00:00Z).
Reference.color: A CSS colour, with transparency for a band (#E5393514). Empty: the colour of the theme.
Reference.label: Text drawn at the line or band. Empty: none.
Reference.labelAt: Where along the line or band the label stands.
Reference.behind: Whether it is drawn behind the layers of the chart, or in front of them.
Reference.dash: Line: the dash pattern in pixels, comma-separated (4,2). Empty: solid.

SpecTab.label: Spec
SpecTab.explain: The whole Vega-Lite spec the chart draws. What you change here beyond the form is kept as an override; the form still decides the rest. URLs, links and data of its own are taken out.
SpecTab.unused: Overrides that find nothing to change
SpecTab.noWidget: The widget is not on this board.
